name: Multi-Grid Ray Traversal with Adaptive Step Size
definition: A CUDA kernel that traverses rays through one or more axis-aligned bounding box (AABB) voxel grids, handling overlapping grids by priority, and outputting traversal intervals and sample points with adaptive step sizing based on cone angle.
summary: Multi-Grid Ray Traversal with Adaptive Step Size traverses multiple voxel grids using sorted intersection events to prioritize overlapping regions, unlike particle grids that rely on density accumulation.
